constraints.description: Edges have no attribute slot: (src,dst,rel,provenance) with PK (src,dst,rel).
constraints.implication: FK column pairs need either a rel encoding (`references:store_id->id`) or an `attrs` column schema bump on every backend.

constraints.description: Bare-id routing is by kind prefix: the first overlay whose overlay_prefixes contain the kind wins.
constraints.implication: Kind must be the first segment of every id (`table:`, `schema:`, `source:`); the owner's origin:object form lives in the second segment.

constraints.description: WikiProjectConfig.backend Literal is sqlite|memory|arangodb; create_wiki_store also accepts postgres.
constraints.implication: A Postgres-hosted production plane needs a plane-specific backend field or a widened Literal.

constraints.description: Ledger mount only happens when find_shared_root(root) is not None; FEAT-569 is adding from_dir()/read_repair=False rootless modes concurrently.
constraints.implication: SchemaPlaneService must ship from_root AND from_dir, and its tools a read_repair switch; coordinate merge order with FEAT-569 on mcp_server.py, cli.py and the tool bundle; the tool-surface golden test will change.

constraints.description: Two TableMetadata dataclasses exist (bots/database with completeness/source; parrot_tools/database legacy without).
constraints.implication: The plane must import parrot.bots.database.models.TableMetadata explicitly and provide an adapter if databasequery ever feeds it.

constraints.description: DatabaseAgent keys partitions/router by tk_id = f'{database_type}_{primary_schema}'.
constraints.implication: origin alias must be mapped from tk_id (or declared on DatabaseToolkitConfig); do not rename tk_id.

constraints.description: CachePartition Redis keys already use the string prefix `table:{schema}:{table}`.
constraints.implication: Not a functional conflict (Redis vs wiki) but grep/log ambiguity; document, or namespace plane ids in log lines.

constraints.description: The managed git hook block is shared by post-commit and post-merge and guarded by `[ ! -f .git ]`.
constraints.implication: DDL ingest goes inside the same guard as one more line — no new hook.

constraints.description: sqlglot.parse aborts a whole file on one ParseError; inline PRIMARY KEY is a column constraint, not exp.PrimaryKey.
constraints.implication: ingest-ddl must split statements and isolate errors per statement, and fold column-level constraints; 6/32 in-repo files fail whole-file today.

constraints.description: knowledge/wiki is a hot area (201 commits/30d) while bots/database is quiet (6/60d).
constraints.implication: Land wiki-side lanes in small PRs rebased often; the database-side lane is low-conflict.
A sqlglot-based DDL renderer is new code, not a replacement; keep _internal untouched.

unknowns.question: Final id grammar: kind-first `table:<origin>/<schema>.<table>` (routing-safe, recommended) vs bare `<origin>:<schema>.<table>` (owner's literal form, requires every origin alias in overlay_prefixes) vs one namespace per origin (`bigquery::table:epson.sales`)?
plausible_answers: a) kind-first table:<origin>/<schema>.<table>, with normalize_ref() accepting bare bigquery:epson.sales on input (recommended)
b) bare origin:object as concept id; add each alias to overlay_prefixes
c) one overlay namespace per origin

unknowns.question: FK edge payload: encode the column pair in rel (`references:store_id->id`) or add an optional `attrs` JSON column to edges on every backend (schema bump; also benefits `calls` edges)?
plausible_answers: a) attrs JSON column on edges (schema v3) — cleaner, touches sqlite/memory/arango/postgres stores
b) rel encoding — zero schema change, ugly, breaks rel filtering
c) store column pairs only in the table page body / columns side table; edge stays plain `references`

unknowns.question: Merge rule when live sync and DDL ingest both produce a page for one origin?
plausible_answers: a) newest introspected_at wins per table; defined_in edges always kept; conflicts reported by `schema diff` (recommended)
b) live always authoritative; DDL contributes only defined_in edges
c) separate origins (e.g. `formdesigner-ddl` vs `formdesigner`) — never merged

unknowns.question: Production placement: schema.db file shipped/mounted with the DatabaseAgent, or a shared postgres/arangodb-backed SchemaStore (needs backend widening) — and should v1 already depend on FEAT-569's from_dir()/remote mode?
plausible_answers: a) v1 = SQLite schema.db with from_root + from_dir; backend swap as a follow-up once FEAT-569 lands (recommended)
b) v1 includes create_wiki_store(backend=…) plane with widened Literal
c) v1 waits for FEAT-569 and mounts the plane in the remote server only

unknowns.question: Origin key: map tk_id → origin inside DatabaseAgent, or add an explicit `origin` field to DatabaseToolkitConfig (default = database_type)?
plausible_answers: a) explicit origin on DatabaseToolkitConfig defaulting to database_type; DatabaseAgent passes it to the partition (recommended)
b) derive origin from tk_id by convention
c) rename tk_id to the origin alias (breaks query_router registration)
